start_here: Say to your AI: "Show me the timeline of my plan chain-fixture from request.json before I cut it, then build the cut." It reads the tool row, runs the cutter on your computer and reports each check.
no_lists_because: It keeps no list of yours: it reads the request file and the plan files in the folder you name and writes only those files or the cut.
instructions: 1. Clone the Workshop checkout, run python3 -m pip install -U numpy soundfile pillow blake3 and brew install ffmpeg node.
2. Write request.json: pieces (what each segment kind becomes), plans {folder}, clips {words_folder}, looks, voice, face_reader, overlay_renderer, devices, checks and folders {work, seen}.

3. Say "Show me the timeline of my plan chain-fixture"; the AI reads the row with tools:list and runs python3 tools/assemble-a-plan-into-a-cut/do-work/assemble.py timeline --request request.json chain-fixture.
4. Read the last JSON line: the segment order with start and dur, then run build the same way and read where the cut is and each check's pass or fail.
5. When a check failed the cut stays in the work folder; change nothing you chose to make it pass.
